Model pictures above are existing gallery references, not new episode evidence. Each player carries its recorded render and validation status. Synthetic development fixtures are excluded from this player gallery.

A rendered video does not certify motion or human contact. Failed checks remain visible. Unsupported probes and separator context videos do not count as demonstrated scenarios. This is representative coverage, not exhaustive rendering of every applicable combination.

Communication and assessment evidence

In this edition, 8 of 46 filmed cases in this 50-case group have timestamped dialogue in a recording. Each applicable card links its dialogue to the player. The figures below come from the communication study in the signed report. The signed data identifies artifacts/scenarios/campaigns/20261112_misgrasp.

5Interaction videos in the signed study

39Episodes with no communication record

These counts describe recorded artifacts. Text declarations are not audible speech. Action records do not establish perceived uncertainty, and evaluator predicates do not establish assistant detection. Each episode keeps these sources separate.

Opening this report

Open this HTML file in a web browser for video playback. Some editor previews block scripts or media. All episode cards and evidence links are included directly in the HTML; filters and in-page seeking use JavaScript.

For a local web server with video seeking, run from the repository root:

cd /mnt/d/legosim
python3 -m legosim.cli.serve

Open this edition’s scenario catalog at /report/v4-2026-11-15/site/report/scenarios/index.html.

Historical rerender · 79 frames at 12 fps

accidental disassembly

40013-1 · Halloween Ghost · ldraw-6 after · mistake

Observable behavior

  • 0:00.00 A small white assembly is centered between two lowered hands.
  • 0:00.50 The small white top remains exposed, with the right and left hands at its sides.
  • 0:01.25 The back of the right hand moves over the white assembly and hides the grasp.
  • 0:02.08 A white edge of the lifted item is visible beside the raised right fingertips, with a separate white base below.
  • 0:02.17 The right hand stays raised, leaving a small visible gap between the held white section and the white base.
  • 0:02.42 The right hand stays raised, leaving a small visible gap between the held white section and the white base.
  • 0:02.75 The right hand stays raised, leaving a small visible gap between the held white section and the white base.
  • 0:02.83 A studded white face appears clearly beside the raised hand, above the separate base on the table.
  • 0:03.83 The back of the right hand obscures the receiving joint while it descends toward the base.
  • 0:04.92 The right fingers release and withdraw beside the small white assembly.
  • 0:06.50 The hands lie apart and the upper part of the white build is visible again. The motion shows removal and placement without a visible jolt beforehand.

Historical rerender · 89 frames at 12 fps

attachment location

1211-2 · Small House Set · ldraw-4 during · assistance

Observable behavior

  • 0:00.00 A small red and white assembly is centered on the table. Both hands rest apart below it.
  • 0:00.50 The right index finger extends from the bottom right. The small build is fully in view and there is a separate blue piece to its right.
  • 0:01.42 The extended right index looms close to the camera and covers nearly the entire assembly. Only a sliver of the white base and a blue corner remain visible below it.
  • 0:02.33 Both hands have lowered to opposite sides, revealing the small build again.
  • 0:02.42 The red build is still exposed between the two resting hands.
  • 0:02.83 The view has turned left. The right forearm stretches diagonally across the table and its hand closes over the pickup location. The red assembly remains visible on the right.
  • 0:03.25 The right hand is curled against the tabletop; the contacted piece is hidden by the fingers.
  • 0:03.33 The curled hand still fills the left side of the shot; the object being lifted is obscured.
  • 0:04.50 The right wrist bends sharply over the build. A blue round end can be seen between the right fingertips by the right-hand edge of the white base.
  • 0:05.75 The right fingers have opened into a wide C above and to the right of the model. Both sides of the red and white build are exposed again.
  • 0:07.33 The right hand has retreated to the lower right and the left remains at the lower left. The small red assembly is visible in the center with blue at either end.
